Independent candidates protest slipper-like election symbols in Dausa

In the Dausa constituency of Rajasthan, the Election Commission assigned election symbols to independent candidates that resembled a slipper (chappal). Several independent candidates received the slipper-like symbols. The candidates expressed anger over the symbols. They publicly demanded that the symbols be changed. The protest included strong objections during the election process.
